finalists.label: Pilomatrixoma
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings, including multilocular spaces, basophilic cells, and shadow cells, with no evidence against it.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of basophilic cells and shadow cells in the deep dermis, along with the multilocular spaces and chalky-white cut surface, are highly specific findings that point to Pilomatrixoma.
